name: language-rooting
body:
Feature language-rooting (user decision — Human decision, folded into the scanner-optimisation change-set; do not re-litigate). A `Language` code-graph node kind plus language-rooted FQNs: every scanned language becomes the disjoint root of its own module namespace, so cross-language module/symbol FQN collisions are impossible by construction.

The ingestor derives one `Language` node per language actually scanned from the existing `lang_switch` control record (NOT scanner-emitted), makes each module a child of its language node (`Language —Contains→ Module`), and prefixes every module FQN with the language id (symbols inherit through `parent.name`). Today module FQNs are emitted verbatim with no cross-language namespace and the ingestor SILENTLY SHADOWS a module whose FQN is already claimed (module-vs-module or module-vs-type) — silent data loss; only same-kind Struct/Function collisions panic.

Because every code FQN changes, every existing authored `implemented-by` target becomes DRIFT and must be migrated to its rooted FQN (sequenced: FQN change lands → branch re-scan → re-point the edges).

Decomposes into the Language node kind, the Language→Module containment, the rooted module FQN, symbol inheritance, cross-language collision-freedom, the implemented-by migration, and the FQN-convention docs/tooling update. Feature language-rooting.
